The harbor_promo_register_audit task completed successfully with a perfect reward score, validating the core logic and pytest integration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.95 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed all tests (1/1) using version 8.4.1. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules for Bedrock and SageMaker suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to cloud runtimes.
